reviews.reason: The artifact repair expressly permits a discriminator-keyed note while the filename contract rejects mode/condition text. Use the filename grammar consistently.

Literal artifact-reference defects and identifier-shape defects have overlapping homes. Consolidate ownership without merging separate semantic defects.

Source snapshots do not establish historical approval, questioning or search. Explicit evidence classes and an unevidenced disposition prevent both invented failures and unsupported passes.
The stricter output-reference style can coexist with general anaphora exceptions. Choose a semantic uniqueness or machine-format rationale explicitly; this is not a contradiction.
Activity-file guidance is a permitted repair in one entry and always a violation in another. The technique/shared-delivery solution satisfies both objectives.
